gameName: VivaJava: The Coffee Game: The Dice Game
editionLabel: Dice Hate Me Games English edition, 2014
firstPlayerRule: Everyone rolls one Coffee Die. The highest roller starts; reroll any ties.
officialTieBreak: Reroll ties for the highest Coffee Die result.
clarifications: Each other player adds one Research Point to the color Research Track they rolled.
The opening uses this game’s Coffee Dice and Research Tracks.

internalEvidence: The ©2014 Dice Hate Me Games Field Manual gives the highest Coffee Die roll, rerolls ties, and awards one color-matched Research Point to each other player on page 3. The title and credits match inventory BGG 139899. SHA-256: 4ca99d05878b67a11b85c4dc1f9e05c5009b00cc9ad908e3d2ce3b1101e667bb. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-22. Editorial review 2026-09-24: Rechecked the cited pages, opening instruction, game identity, and edition.
uncertainty: The rulebook does not say whether all players or only tied players reroll; the tie wording is retained without narrowing it.
